units.source_text: 已经是三个钟头以前的事了。

en.t: That had already been three hours earlier.

units.source_text: 岛村感到百无聊赖，发呆地凝望着不停活动的左手的食指。

en.t: Bored to distraction, Shimamura stared blankly at the index finger of his left hand as it kept moving.

units.source_text: 因为只有这个手指，才能使他清楚地感到就要去会见的那个女人。

en.t: For only that finger could make him clearly feel the woman he was on his way to meet.

units.source_text: 奇怪的是，越是急于想把她清楚地回忆起来，印象就越模糊。

en.t: Strangely, the more urgently he tried to recall her clearly, the more blurred his impression became.

units.source_text: 在这扑朔迷离的记忆中，也只有这手指所留下的几许感触，把他带到远方的女人身边。

en.t: In that confused and indistinct memory, only the faint sensations left in this finger carried him to the woman far away.

units.source_text: 他想着想着，不由地把手指送到鼻子边闻了闻。

en.t: As he thought on, he unconsciously brought the finger to his nose and smelled it.

units.source_text: 当他无意识地用这个手指在窗玻璃上划道时，不知怎的，上面竟清晰地映出一只女人的眼睛。

en.t: When he unconsciously traced a line on the windowpane with that finger, somehow a woman's eye appeared clearly reflected there.

units.source_text: 他大吃一惊，几乎喊出声来。

en.t: He was so startled that he almost cried out.

units.source_text: 大概是他的心飞向了远方的缘故。

en.t: It was probably because his mind had flown far away.

units.source_text: 他定神看时，什么也没有。

en.t: When he focused his eyes, there was nothing there.

units.source_text: 映在玻璃窗上的，是对座那个女人的形象。

en.t: What was reflected in the window glass was the figure of the woman sitting opposite him.

units.source_text: 外面昏暗下来，车厢里的灯亮了。

en.t: Outside it had grown dim, and the lights in the carriage had come on.

units.source_text: 这样，窗玻璃就成了一面镜子。

en.t: In this way, the window glass had become a mirror.

units.source_text: 然而，由于放了暖气，玻璃上蒙了一层水蒸气，在他用手指揩亮玻璃之前，那面镜子其实并不存在。

en.t: However, because the heat was on, the glass was clouded with a layer of steam, and before he wiped it clear with his finger, that mirror had not really existed.
